Ladakh Celebrates First Black-Necked Crane Festival

Ladakh has hosted its first-ever Black-Necked Crane Festival. Lieutenant Governor VK Saxena inaugurated the event. The festival aims to celebrate and conserve the endangered Black-Necked Crane, a significant species in the region's ecosystem. This initiative marks a notable effort in promoting biodiversity and ecotourism in Ladakh.
